notes.title: Handyman Corporation Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are bringing you an update based on the feedback that we received from you. We are very thankful for the positive and negative comments based on your experience with the game. Both are quite valuable for us. Changelog of the latest patch:

- Delivery times adjustements

- Minigame improvements

- Bug Fixing


Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Hotfix Update #4
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are bringing you a hotfix based on the feedback that we received from you. We are very thankful for the positive and negative comments based on your first hand experience with the game. Both are quite valuable for us. We fixed the following issues:

• Screwing mechanic sensitivity

• Performance issues due to large amounts of contracts

• Unable to fix TVs at certain points

• Unable to fix TV stands at certain points

• Wife getting bugged and merging with objects

• Other small bugs and improvements

We apologize for any inconvenience that the bugs may have caused.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Delay in the release date
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are sorry to announce that there will be a further delay in the release of the game. The reason for this delay is that we have discovered a serious bug that needs to be fixed before we can release the game.

We know that many of you have been eagerly anticipating the release of the game and we apologize for any inconvenience this delay may have caused. We are working diligently to fix the bug and will release the game as soon as it is ready, which we now expect to be in two days.

Planned release date 12/16/2022 at 10:00 AM CET 

We apologize again for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
